title: 第1159章 船上的规矩第1158章 古船
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
刚说完，悬在云下的古渡便撞上岸桩，船尾血雾被震开一道缝。
一名肩宽臂长的苍梧修士从雾里看见岸边支灯易主。
看向很是陌生的顾平。
他没有任何犹豫，知道这艘船完全不能落入外人手里。
也因此他抬起鱼骨长弩便向叶青篱扣下机关。
弩臂弹开的声音才传到岸上。
叶青篱腰间剑鳞提前鸣响，这个剑鳞似乎不受控制地在呼应那船上的凶兵。她强行压住即将展开的剑道法相。
剑锋仅仅出鞘三寸，便将听见的那一声弦震沿原路送了回去。
一道薄得近乎看不见的青色剑音穿过湖雾，先把鱼骨箭从中剖开，再擦过苍梧修士右肩，血雾里顿时飞起半片护肩与一串热血，那人的肩背也被切开一道深可见骨的斜口。
叶青篱腰侧才黏住的灵脉同时崩开一处，青裙下的仙丝陷进血肉，她用剑鞘撑住岸桩才没有跪下，呼吸压了数次，脸上仍失去了最后一点血色。
倒湖水压沿着落下的跳板倾泻过来。
顾平身上有着死气，所以他艺高人胆大。
抬腿就踩上湖面上的一块腐木，一瞬间波浪掀起来没，这水波似乎有着玄妙的气场。
他只觉得肩头微沉，叶青篱隔着十余步承受余波，腰侧伤口便又向外渗出一线鲜血。
她看了一眼血雾里那名捂住肩背的苍梧修士，主动退到跳板之外：“两件渡劫兵器，九件炼虚兵器，船腹还有两个伏兵，我能听见的都告诉你了。”
“在岸上等着。”
顾平将支灯灰雾压进骨缝，踏上古渡时，船舷下方伸出的泡胀尸手贴着他鞋面、脚踝和膝弯一路摸到腰侧，触到那层完整死气以后才缩回腐木。
铜铃即将响起，叶青篱隔着翻涌湖雾叫住他：“莫问。”
顾平回头。
她右手按着重新裂开的腰伤，左手仍握着剑，方才想说的许多话最后只剩一句：“活着回来，青铜剑鳞的账还没算完，你要帮助我寻找到那件宝物啊。”

顾平看了一眼岸上年长水工掌心紧握的周九犬齿，又看向水工身边那一地断环：“先把伤缝好，也替他们守住灯下剩的人。”
古渡离开岸桩的刹那，外界山河在所有人眼前缓慢竖起，原本悬在云上的古湖翻到船底，群山与渡口则贴上远处一堵看不见尽头的石墙。
连叶青篱那道扶剑而立的青影也跟着横了过来。
真正登上船之后，他才发现此地更有玄妙的空间所在。此船上，在外界看只有他一人而已，实则他登入之后才发现此地还有别人。
除顾平与方才出手的苍梧一行之外，船上另外十一名随真尸登船的活人。
刺客见到顾平。
这些死尸立刻被腕上黑发拽回各自死客身边，一位父亲跪坐在死去的女儿脚下，双手死死抱住椅腿，另一名送兄长回乡的年轻人刚想放出护体道域，缠着他手腕的细发已经勒进皮肉，座椅里的尸体也同时张开了嘴。
content_en:
As soon as he finished speaking, the ancient ferry hanging under the clouds hit the shore pile, and a crack was opened in the blood mist at the stern.
A Cangwu monk with broad shoulders and long arms saw from the fog that a lamp on the shore changed hands.
He looked at the very unfamiliar Gu Ping.
He did not hesitate, knowing that the ship could not fall into the hands of outsiders.
Therefore, he raised the fishbone crossbow and pulled the trap on Ye Qingli.
The sound of the crossbow arm springing back reached the shore.
The sword scales on Ye Qingli's waist sounded in advance, and the sword scales seemed to be uncontrollably responding to the fierce soldiers on the ship. She forcibly suppressed the kendo method that was about to unfold.
The blade of the sword was only three inches out of its sheath, and the sound of the string vibration was heard and sent back along the original path.
A blue sword sound that was so thin that it was almost invisible passed through the lake mist. It first cut open the fish bone arrow, and then grazed the right shoulder of Cangwu monk. Half a shoulder guard and a string of blood suddenly flew up in the blood mist. The man's shoulder and back were also cut with a deep slant with visible bones.
The spiritual veins attached to Ye Qingli's waist burst open at the same time, and the fairy silk under her green skirt sank into her flesh and blood. She used the sheath of her sword to support the pile to prevent herself from kneeling down. She breathed several times, but her face still lost the last bit of color.
The water pressure of the lake poured down along the falling springboard.
Gu Ping has the aura of death in him, so he is very talented and bold.
I raised my legs and stepped on a piece of rotten wood on the lake. In an instant, the waves rose up. The waves seemed to have a mysterious aura.
He only felt his shoulders sinking slightly. Ye Qingli endured the aftermath for more than ten steps, and a line of blood oozed out from the wound on his waist.
She glanced at the Cangwu monk in the blood mist who was covering his shoulders and back, and took the initiative to retreat away from the springboard: "Two tribulation weapons, nine void refining weapons, and there are two ambushes in the belly of the ship. I'll tell you everything I can hear."
"Waiting on the shore."
Gu Ping pressed the gray mist of the branch lamp into the seam of his bones, and when he stepped onto the ancient ferry, the swollen corpse hands stretched out from under the side of the boat touched the tops of his shoes, ankles and knees all the way to his waist. They retracted into the rotten wood after touching the layer of complete lifelessness.
The bell was about to ring, and Ye Qingli stopped him through the rolling lake fog: "Don't ask."
Gu Ping turned around.
She pressed her right hand on the re-opened waist wound, while her left hand still held the sword. Of the many words she wanted to say, she only had one sentence left: "Come back alive, the debt of the bronze sword scale has not been settled yet, you have to help me find that treasure."
Gu Ping glanced at Zhou Jiu's canines clenched in the palm of the older sailor's hand on the shore, and then looked at the broken ring next to the sailor: "Sew up the wounds first, and also hold the remaining people under the lamp for them."
The moment the ancient ferry left the shore piles, the mountains and rivers outside slowly stood up in front of everyone's eyes. The ancient lake that was originally suspended above the clouds rolled over to the bottom of the boat, and the mountains and the ferry were attached to an endless stone wall in the distance.
Even the green figure of Ye Qingli, who was standing with his sword in hand, also came over.
After actually boarding the ship, he discovered that there was an even more mysterious space here. From the outside, he was the only one on this ship, but in fact, after he logged in, he discovered that there was someone else here.
In addition to Gu Ping and Cang Wu who had just taken action, there were eleven other living people on the ship who boarded the ship with the real corpse.
The assassin saw Gu Ping.
The dead bodies were immediately dragged back to their respective dead guests by the black hair on their wrists. A father knelt down at the feet of his dead daughter and hugged the chair legs tightly with both hands. Another young man who was sending his brother back home was just about to let go of the body protection realm. The thin hair wrapped around his wrists had been cut into the flesh, and the corpse in the seat also opened its mouth at the same time.
